changelog: Device Settings aligned to the B_1.2 handoff export.

Rows 51 -> 68 tall, grouped the way the design groups them: [Device Name, Display Icon] / [Device Info] / [Sleep Mode, Battery Priority, Smart Schedule] / [Delete Device 52], 12px inside a group and 24px between groups.
Display Icon shows the glyph itself instead of a tinted chip, and falls back to the device-type icon inferred from the name (same rule as the device card) until one is picked.
Row label moves to ink-2 and the chevron to the design's own chevron-right SVG.
All five DeviceDetailPage headers use the measured Page Header box (inset + 20 top, 20 bottom); the main title goes 18 -> 20.
